question.en: Choose the correct form of the verb to fill in the blank: 'He _____ to school every day.'
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए क्रिया का सही रूप चुनें: 'He _____ to school every day.'

explanation.en: A singular subject ('He') takes a singular verb (V1 + s/es, i.e., 'goes') in the simple present tense.
explanation.hi: एक एक वचन कर्ता ('He') साधारण वर्तमान काल में एक वचन क्रिया (V1 + s/es, अर्थात 'goes') लेता है।

question.en: Select the correct verb for the sentence: 'They _____ playing cricket now.'
question.hi: वाक्य के लिए सही क्रिया चुनें: 'They _____ playing cricket now.'

explanation.en: The subject 'They' is plural, so it takes the plural helping verb 'are'.
explanation.hi: कर्ता 'They' बहुवचन है, इसलिए यह बहुवचन सहायक क्रिया 'are' लेता है।

question.en: Fill in the blank with the correct verb: 'Each of the students _____ given a prize.'
question.hi: सही क्रिया के साथ रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Each of the students _____ given a prize.'

explanation.en: Words like 'Each', 'Every', 'Either', and 'Neither' always take a singular verb regardless of the prepositional phrase following them.
explanation.hi: 'Each', 'Every', 'Either' और 'Neither' जैसे शब्द हमेशा अपने बाद आने वाली संज्ञा के बावजूद एक वचन क्रिया लेते हैं।

question.en: Choose the correct verb: 'Milk _____ white.'
question.hi: सही क्रिया चुनें: 'Milk _____ white.'

explanation.en: 'Milk' is an uncountable noun. Uncountable nouns always take a singular verb.
explanation.hi: 'Milk' एक गणनीय (uncountable) संज्ञा है। अनगिनत संज्ञाएँ हमेशा एक वचन क्रिया लेती हैं।

question.en: Select the correct option: 'Bread and butter _____ my favorite breakfast.'
question.hi: सही विकल्प चुनें: 'Bread and butter _____ my favorite breakfast.'

explanation.en: When two singular nouns connected by 'and' express a single idea or whole (like bread and butter), they take a singular verb.
explanation.hi: जब 'and' से जुड़े दो एकवचन संज्ञाएं एक ही विचार या संपूर्णता को व्यक्त करते हैं (जैसे bread and butter), तो वे एकवचन क्रिया लेते हैं।

question.en: Fill in the blank: 'Slow and steady _____ the race.'
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Slow and steady _____ the race.'

explanation.en: 'Slow and steady' functions as a single proverb/unit representing a unified concept, taking a singular verb ('wins').
explanation.hi: 'Slow and steady' एक संयुक्त कहावत के रूप में कार्य करता है जो एक एकल अवधारणा का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, इसलिए यह एकवचन क्रिया ('wins') लेता है।

question.en: Choose the correct verb: 'Physics _____ a difficult subject for many.'
question.hi: सही क्रिया चुनें: 'Physics _____ a difficult subject for many.'

explanation.en: Names of subjects (like Physics, Mathematics, Economics) end in 's' but are treated as singular and take singular verbs.
explanation.hi: विषयों के नाम (जैसे Physics, Mathematics, Economics) के अंत में 's' होता है लेकिन उन्हें एकवचन माना जाता है और वे एकवचन क्रिया लेते हैं।

question.en: Select the correct form: 'She _____ a great singer.'
question.hi: सही रूप चुनें: 'She _____ a great singer.'

explanation.en: The pronoun 'She' is singular and takes the singular verb 'is'.
explanation.hi: सर्वनाम 'She' एकवचन है और इसके साथ एकवचन क्रिया 'is' का प्रयोग होता है।

question.en: Fill in the blank: 'The quality of these mangoes _____ not good.'
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The quality of these mangoes _____ not good.'

explanation.en: The real subject is 'quality' (singular), not 'mangoes'. Therefore, it takes the singular verb 'is'.
explanation.hi: वास्तविक कर्ता 'quality' (एकवचन) है, न कि 'mangoes'। इसलिए यह एकवचन क्रिया 'is' लेता है।

question.en: Choose the correct verb: 'Dogs _____ barking.'
question.hi: सही क्रिया चुनें: 'Dogs _____ barking.'

explanation.en: 'Dogs' is a plural subject, so it takes the plural helping verb 'are'.
explanation.hi: 'Dogs' एक बहुवचन कर्ता है, इसलिए यह बहुवचन सहायक क्रिया 'are' लेता है।

question.en: Choose the correct verb: 'The captain, along with his crew members, _____ drowned.'
question.hi: सही क्रिया चुनें: 'The captain, along with his crew members, _____ drowned.'

explanation.en: When subjects are connected by 'along with', 'as well as', 'together with', the verb agrees strictly with the FIRST subject ('The captain' -> singular, hence 'was').
explanation.hi: जब कर्ता 'along with', 'as well as', 'together with' से जुड़े होते हैं, तो क्रिया पहले कर्ता ('The captain' -> एकवचन, अतः 'was') के अनुसार होती है।

question.en: Select the correct option: 'Neither the teacher nor the students _____ present.'
question.hi: सही विकल्प चुनें: 'Neither the teacher nor the students _____ present.'

explanation.en: With 'Neither...nor' or 'Either...or', the verb agrees with the NEAREST subject ('the students' -> plural, hence 'were').
explanation.hi: 'Neither...nor' या 'Either...or' के साथ, क्रिया सबसे पास वाले कर्ता ('the students' -> बहुवचन, अतः 'were') के अनुसार होती है।

question.en: Fill in the blank: 'A number of accidents _____ reported recently.'
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'A number of accidents _____ reported recently.'

explanation.en: 'A number of' denotes plurality and takes a plural verb ('have been'), whereas 'The number of' takes a singular verb.
explanation.hi: 'A number of' बहुवचन को दर्शाता है और बहुवचन क्रिया ('have been') लेता है, जबकि 'The number of' एकवचन क्रिया लेता है।

question.en: Choose the correct verb: 'The number of students in the class _____ fifty.'
question.hi: सही क्रिया चुनें: 'The number of students in the class _____ fifty.'

explanation.en: 'The number of' refers to a specific count/sum and always takes a singular verb ('is').
explanation.hi: 'The number of' एक विशिष्ट संख्या को संदर्भित करता है और हमेशा एकवचन क्रिया ('is') लेता है।

question.en: Select the correct verb: 'Ten miles _____ a long distance to walk.'
question.hi: सही क्रिया चुनें: 'Ten miles _____ a long distance to walk.'

explanation.en: When a plural noun denotes a specific quantity, distance, time, or amount considered as a single unit, it takes a singular verb.
explanation.hi: जब कोई बहुवचन संज्ञा किसी निश्चित मात्रा, दूरी, समय या राशि को एक इकाई के रूप में दर्शाती है, तो वह एकवचन क्रिया लेती है।

question.en: Fill in the blank: 'Many a soldier _____ sacrificed his life for the country.'
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Many a soldier _____ sacrificed his life for the country.'

explanation.en: Although 'Many a' implies multiple, grammatically 'Many a + singular noun' takes a singular verb ('has').
explanation.hi: यद्यपि 'Many a' कई का बोध कराता है, लेकिन व्याकरण के अनुसार 'Many a + एकवचन संज्ञा' के साथ एकवचन क्रिया ('has') का प्रयोग होता है।

question.en: Choose the correct form: 'The committee _____ divided in their opinions.'
question.hi: सही रूप चुनें: 'The committee _____ divided in their opinions.'

explanation.en: Collective nouns take a plural verb when members are divided in opinion or acting individually ('are').
explanation.hi: समूहवाचक संज्ञाएँ (Collective nouns) बहुवचन क्रिया लेती हैं जब उनके सदस्य विभाजित होते हैं या व्यक्तिगत रूप से कार्य करते हैं ('are')।

question.en: Select the correct option: 'All the furniture _____ sold out.'
question.hi: सही विकल्प चुनें: 'All the furniture _____ sold out.'

explanation.en: Nouns like furniture, scenery, advice, and information are uncountable and always take singular verbs ('was').
explanation.hi: furniture, scenery, advice और information जैसी संज्ञाएँ अनगिनत (uncountable) हैं और हमेशा एकवचन क्रिया ('was') लेती हैं।

question.en: Fill in the blank: 'Either he or I _____ to blame.'
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Either he or I _____ to blame.'

explanation.en: With 'Either...or', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. Since 'I' is nearest, it takes 'am'.
explanation.hi: 'Either...or' के साथ, क्रिया सबसे पास वाले कर्ता के अनुसार होती है। चूँकि 'I' सबसे पास है, यह 'am' लेता है।

question.en: Choose the correct verb: 'Mathematics _____ my favorite subject.'
question.hi: सही क्रिया चुनें: 'Mathematics _____ my favorite subject.'

explanation.en: Names of sciences or branches of learning ending in -ics take a singular verb when used as a single subject.
explanation.hi: -ics पर समाप्त होने वाले विज्ञान या अध्ययन की शाखाओं के नाम जब एक विषय के रूप में प्रयुक्त होते हैं, तो एकवचन क्रिया लेते हैं।

question.en: Identify the sentence with correct Subject-Verb Agreement:
question.hi: सही कर्त्ता-क्रिया संगति (Subject-Subject Agreement) वाले वाक्य को पहचानें:

text.en: The poet and novelist have passed away.
text.hi: The poet and novelist have passed away.

text.en: The poet and the novelist has passed away.
text.hi: The poet and the novelist has passed away.

text.en: The poet and novelist has passed away.
text.hi: The poet and novelist has passed away.

text.en: The poets and novelist has passed away.
text.hi: The poets and novelist has passed away.

explanation.en: When an article ('The') is used only before the first noun, it refers to the same person, taking a singular verb ('has').
explanation.hi: जब आर्टिकल ('The') केवल पहले संज्ञा के पहले प्रयोग हो, तो वह एक ही व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है, अतः एकवचन क्रिया ('has') लगती है।

question.en: Choose the correct verb for the conditional statement: 'I wish I _____ a king.'
question.hi: शर्त वाले वाक्य के लिए सही क्रिया चुनें: 'I wish I _____ a king.'

explanation.en: In imaginary/subjunctive sentences expressing unfulfilled wishes ('I wish', 'If'), 'were' is used with all subjects.
explanation.hi: काल्पनिक इच्छाओं ('I wish', 'If') को व्यक्त करने वाले वाक्यों में सभी कर्ताओं के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है।

question.en: Select the correct option: 'The jury _____ unanimous in its decision.'
question.hi: सही विकल्प चुनें: 'The jury _____ unanimous in its decision.'

explanation.en: When a collective noun acts as a single unified body (unanimous), it takes a singular verb ('was').
explanation.hi: जब एक समूहवाचक संज्ञा एक एकीकृत इकाई के रूप में कार्य करती है (सर्वसम्मति), तो वह एकवचन क्रिया ('was') लेती है।

question.en: Fill in the blank: 'More than one person _____ involved in the scam.'
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'More than one person _____ involved in the scam.'

explanation.en: Despite meaning plural, 'More than one + singular noun' takes a strict singular verb ('was').
explanation.hi: बहुवचन का अर्थ होने के बावजूद, 'More than one + एकवचन संज्ञा' के साथ एकवचन क्रिया ('was') का प्रयोग होता है।

question.en: Choose the correct verb: 'The Arabian Nights _____ a wonderful book of stories.'
question.hi: सही क्रिया चुनें: 'The Arabian Nights _____ a wonderful book of stories.'

explanation.en: Titles of books, movies, or proper names that are plural in form take a singular verb if they refer to a single entity.
explanation.hi: पुस्तकों, फिल्मों या उचित नामों के शीर्षक जो रूप में बहुवचन हैं, यदि वे एक इकाई को संदर्भित करते हैं तो एकवचन क्रिया लेते हैं।

question.en: Select the correct form: 'What _____ the news today?'
question.hi: सही रूप चुनें: 'What _____ the news today?'

explanation.en: Nouns like 'news', 'ethics', and 'politics' look plural due to 's' at the end, but are grammatically singular ('is').
explanation.hi: 'news', 'ethics' और 'politics' जैसी संज्ञाएँ अंत में 's' के कारण बहुवचन दिखती हैं, लेकिन व्याकरण की दृष्टि से एकवचन हैं ('is')।

question.en: Fill in the blank: 'Three-fourths of the book _____ read by me.'
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Three-fourths of the book _____ read by me.'

explanation.en: When fractions/percentages ('Three-fourths') are followed by a singular countable noun ('the book'), they take a singular verb ('has been').
explanation.hi: जब भिन्नों/प्रतिशत ('Three-fourths') के बाद एकवचन गणनीय संज्ञा ('the book') हो, तो वे एकवचन क्रिया ('has been') लेते हैं।

question.en: Choose the correct verb: 'Cattle _____ grazing in the field.'
question.hi: सही क्रिया चुनें: 'Cattle _____ grazing in the field.'

explanation.en: Nouns like 'cattle', 'peasantry', 'gentry', and 'police' look singular in form but are always treated as plural ('are').
explanation.hi: 'cattle', 'peasantry', 'gentry' और 'police' जैसी संज्ञाएँ रूप में एकवचन दिखती हैं लेकिन हमेशा बहुवचन मानी जाती हैं ('are')।

question.en: Select the correct option: 'Gully Boy _____ a popular movie.'
question.hi: सही विकल्प चुनें: 'Gully Boy _____ a popular movie.'

explanation.en: A singular proper title of a movie or book takes a singular verb ('is').
explanation.hi: किसी फिल्म या पुस्तक का एकवचन उचित शीर्षक एकवचन क्रिया ('is') लेता है।

question.en: Identify the correct sentence:
question.hi: सही वाक्य को पहचानें:

text.en: He is one of those men who does the work sincerely.
text.hi: He is one of those men who does the work sincerely.

text.en: He is one of those men who do the work sincerely.
text.hi: He is one of those men who do the work sincerely.

text.en: He are one of those men who do the work sincerely.
text.hi: He are one of those men who do the work sincerely.

text.en: He is one of those men who is doing sincerely.
text.hi: He is one of those men who is doing sincerely.

explanation.en: In the structure 'one of + plural noun + relative pronoun (who/which)', the verb following the relative pronoun agrees with the plural noun ('men' -> 'do').
explanation.hi: संरचना 'one of + बहुवचन संज्ञा + संबंधित सर्वनाम (who/which)' में, संबंधित सर्वनाम के बाद आने वाली क्रिया बहुवचन संज्ञा के अनुसार होती है ('men' -> 'do')।
